name: smwsprites-portable-orb-of-teleportation
title: Portable Orb of Teleportation
description:
The Portable Orb of Teleportation, or P.O.O.T. is a useful sprite for teleporting the player around. Pressing L or R will teleport the player to the orb, and holding a direction during the teleport will cause the player to be launched in that direction after the teleport is finished. The P.O.O.T. is a single use sprite that destroys itself after being used once.



Based upon WhiteYoshiEgg's Carryable Pipe Sprite.
